descriptor.description:
1. PROCESS DESCRIPTION

The process begins with solid and liquid feeds entering a leaching circuit, where solids are contacted with acid in a Leach Mixer followed by a Leach reactor. The resulting slurry is separated into a filter cake (sent to Roaster) and a pregnant liquor containing dissolved metals. This liquor undergoes solvent extraction (SX) in two stages: Rougher and Cleaner. In the Rougher stage, metal-loaded organic is scrubbed, stripped, and regenerated for reuse. The loaded organic from the Cleaner stage is stripped to produce a high-purity metal solution, which is then precipitated, filtered, and sent to the Roaster as product feed. Organic phases are circulated through mixers and settlers with make-up and purge streams managed throughout. Acid (HCl or dilute HCl) is added at multiple points for pH control and stripping efficiency.

2. EQUIPMENT AND CONNECTIONS

- Leach Mixer: Receives Liquid Feed and Purge stream; discharges to Leach unit.
- Leach: Receives Solid Feed (dashed line) and output from Leach Mixer; discharges to Solid Liquid Separator.
- Solid Liquid Separator (first): Separates Leach output into Filter Cake (to Roaster) and aqueous liquor (to Leach SX Mixer). Includes retained liquid (dashed return to Leach).
- Leach SX Mixer: Mixes pregnant liquor with rougher organic; discharges to Load section of SX Rougher.
- SX Rougher (green box):
  - Load (3 finite elements): Receives mixed liquor/organic from Leach SX Mixer; discharges loaded organic to Scrub.
  - Scrub (1 finite element Counter-current): Receives loaded organic from Load; receives Dilute HCl; discharges scrubbed organic to Strip.
  - Strip (2 finite elements Counter-current): Receives scrubbed organic; receives HCl; discharges stripped organic to Rougher Organic Mixer.
  - Rougher Organic Mixer: Receives stripped organic and Make-up organic; returns purified organic to Load.
  - Purge stream exits from Strip outlet.
- Precip SX Mixer: Receives aqueous strip product from SX Rougher Strip; discharges to SX Cleaner Load.
- SX Cleaner (gray box):
  - Load (3 finite elements): Receives aqueous from Precip SX Mixer; discharges loaded organic to Strip.
  - Strip (3 finite elements Counter-current): Receives loaded organic; receives HCl; discharges stripped organic to Cleaner Organic Mixer.
  - Cleaner Organic Mixer: Receives stripped organic and Make-up/Purge streams; returns purified organic to Load.
- Precipitation: Receives aqueous strip product from SX Cleaner Strip; discharges to Solid Liquid Separator.
- Solid Liquid Separator (second): Separates precipitation slurry into Filter Cake (to Roaster) and aqueous raffinate (Purge stream); includes retained liquid (dashed return to Precipitation).
- Roaster: Receives Filter Cakes from both Solid Liquid Separators (via dashed lines indicating solid transport).

3. STREAMS AND DIRECTIONS

Organic Streams (red arrows):
- From Rougher Organic Mixer → Load (Rougher)
- From Load (Rougher) → Scrub (Rougher)
- From Scrub (Rougher) → Strip (Rougher)
- From Strip (Rougher) → Rougher Organic Mixer (recycle) + Purge exit
- From Cleaner Organic Mixer → Load (Cleaner)
- From Load (Cleaner) → Strip (Cleaner)
- From Strip (Cleaner) → Cleaner Organic Mixer (recycle) + Make-up/Purge entry

Aqueous Streams (black solid arrows):
- Liquid Feed → Leach Mixer
- Dilute HCl → Scrub (Rougher)
- HCl → Strip (Rougher) and Strip (Cleaner)
- Leach Mixer → Leach
- Leach → Solid Liquid Separator (first)
- Solid Liquid Separator (first) → Leach SX Mixer (pregnant liquor)
- Leach SX Mixer → Load (Rougher)
- Strip (Rougher) → Precip SX Mixer (loaded aqueous)
- Precip SX Mixer → Load (Cleaner)
- Strip (Cleaner) → Precipitation (high-purity aqueous)
- Precipitation → Solid Liquid Separator (second)
- Solid Liquid Separator (second) → Purge exit

Solid Streams (black dashed arrows):
- Solid Feed → Leach
- Solid Liquid Separator (first) → Filter Cake → Roaster
- Solid Liquid Separator (second) → Filter Cake → Roaster
- Retained liquids (dashed returns): 
   - First SLS → Leach
   - Second SLS → Precipitation

4. FINAL CONSISTENCY CHECK

✓ All visible units listed once with inlet/outlet directions mapped per diagram.
✓ No equipment invented — only components explicitly shown in PFD are described.
✓ Stream types (organic/aqueous/solid) matched to legend colors and line styles.
✓ Directionality confirmed via arrowheads on all connecting lines.
✓ “Unclear” labels not required — all major streams and units are clearly labeled.
✓ Process flow traversed left-to-right and by functional section (Leach → SX Rougher → SX Cleaner → Precipitation → Roaster).
✓ Purge and Make-up streams correctly attributed to respective mixer/settler zones.
✓ Counter-current configurations noted where specified (Scrub, Strip sections).
✓ Finite element counts preserved as labeled (e.g., “Load 3 finite elements”).

End of Report.
